tasks.title: E29 in full from its design
tasks.brief: You are the only coder on epic E29 (The ground as a reader). Implement it in full from its product brief docs/product/tdd/E29.md and docs/SYSTEM.md (its module, ports and seams; this epic has no design): every section, and every R, V and D of its acceptance matrix with a test, including end to end tests on the real stack. docs/build/E29/PLAN.md and ticket_tasks in docs/build/E29/tasks.json describe one split of this work with briefs, tests and gates: use them as a guide and checklist; the design and docs/SYSTEM.md win where they differ. Build in this order: domain, application, adapters, api, user interface, and run your tests as you go. If an epic you depend on has no code yet, code against its port protocol and the kernel fakes (docs/SYSTEM.md section 10).

ticket_tasks.title: GroundLink state and durable approved bundle transport
ticket_tasks.brief:
Read AGENTS.md, docs/SYSTEM.md and docs/requests/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md Part A first, in that order, then every reads entry. This brief is the complete assignment for a fresh coder session. There is no E29 design, request file or cold review in the inspected checkout. The product brief sections E29-01 to E29-06 and SYSTEM are the implementation authority; do not create a design. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, contracts/api/ and generated clients do not exist. Recheck current files and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before edits. Never create replacements for E01/provider modules, overwrite concurrent work, edit shared configuration, root tooling, other task files or pharmacy. Ownership expands only the documented SYSTEM 4.1/4.2/6.1 module/feature/test layout for the assigned module. Work only inside owned_paths, with tests there. No git or external service calls.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/normalization and corrections; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Quantity/Unit and generated boundary mappers for seconds/UCUM; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope on HTTP under D5; 5.6 ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle and pinned validated documents; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/DomainEventBus/OutboxSubscriptions and mandatory audience/replication declarations; 5.7.1 ReplicaExchange/Recipient/ProjectionKey/ProjectionRegistration with current field grants and policy epochs; 5.8 complete actor/key/operation/target/semantic-parameter/body CommandIdentity, mission-life ledger, AcceptedReceipt and ResultVisibility; 5.9 reference-only hash-chained audit; 5.10 generation-checked Scheduler with AbsoluteDeadline/ElapsedDeadline; 5.10.1 existing internal TaskQueue/TaskRunner only where asynchronous work is required; 5.11 validated HubSettings/SettingSpec bounds; 5.12 ModuleRegistry and normal module.py discovery. Do not define a replacement transaction, idempotency store, retry runner, clock, file-commit mechanism, lock or public Job kind. SYSTEM 6.2 uses uv run --project hub and explicit hub pytest configuration, not pharmacy's root settings; 6.3 uses pnpm and generated @crew-health/contracts; 6.4 enforces layers and link-reader restrictions. SYSTEM 7 retention/restore, 8.1 seams, 8.3 current object/field privacy, 8.6 durability and 9/10 dependencies/fakes apply.

Only groundlink itself and three consumer purposes read GroundLink: catchup ground presentation, mission Habitat/context and rules ground silence. No plans/help/handoff/assistant direct link import. Never gate care on contact, ACK or reply. E24 alone owns ground-silence warnings; E23 Habitat; E26 preview/press/help lifecycle; E16 handoff/ground console/replies; E20 offline infrastructure; E26/E28/E30 cached content; E03 shell/copy; E21 fixture/runner. Missing named protocol signatures are P29-1, not permission to copy consumer DTOs. Before dependent implementation, coordinator must publish the exact snapshot/UoW-bound signatures, release/origin/recipient/grant semantics and errors in provider-owned application ports and SYSTEM. E16 C2 (docs/build/E16/PLAN.md Requests) also exposes a SYSTEM contradiction: handoff consumes BundleOutbox in 4.2, but 6.4 forbids its import of groundlink.application.ports. P29-1 must resolve that command-only boundary without a fourth GroundLinkQuery reader; do not invent a new module/path or broaden the import allowlist locally. P29-2 covers shared file recovery and bounded complete ground-log shape; P29-3 infrastructure/tooling/traces; P29-4 mounts/content/providers. Return requested changes to the coordinator for filing in docs/requests/E29.md; that path is outside this task. A pending request is not accepted contract support.

All labels/templates/thresholds come from signed pinned documents with provenance. No runtime fixture fallback or clinical default. Operational work uses the existing bounded setting families in PLAN, never guessed names/numbers. Invalid/missing configuration rejects activation and retains last good; open work keeps pins; D1 prevents warning lowering. Every relevant parser/decision gets property tests. Each production module and UI feature gets a scratch nonclinical configuration-label/template edit test with no code change; never edit shipped data or safety mappings. Independent privacy/state expectations are stated separately from generated inputs. Only real adapter inputs retain LIVE/REPLAY/SIM labels; missing, stale, conflicting and unknown facts are never fabricated, averaged or labeled safe.

Tests are first, named with the assigned E29 trace IDs and their R/V/D/invariant. Unit tests may use only actual protocols and E01 kernel.testing. End-to-end tests use create_app(settings) HTTP with real temporary on-disk SQLite and actual configuration/auth/domain/platform modules, or Playwright against that running hub. No in-hub mocks, replacement providers, monkeypatching, SQL seeding, dependency overrides or response interception. Only documented external optional adapter fakes are allowed. Missing positive providers, tools or tests block the corresponding gate, never skip/xfail or silently narrow acceptance. Tests and public evidence use explicit fixtures/demo profiles, no private live data. Run the listed gates with nonempty collection, then report exact passes/failures and blocked prerequisites. Whole-epic completion also needs T4, actual branch/full-condition/complexity/mutation gates whose existing validate_hub commands require E29 inventory propagation under P29-3, CI, independent review and coordinator AI-use rows. No em/en dash or spaced hyphen dash in authored files.

Build only E29-01 and the transport side of E29-04: local GroundLink state, demo HTTP control, scheduled contact evaluation, durable approved bundle attempts/inbox, and ground link agent including file-drop backup. Leave composition/getGroundLog to T2, card to T3 and cross-epic evidence to T4. Source scope: docs/product/tdd/E29.md:19 and :31; CONTRACTS sections 12, 18, 26, 28; SYSTEM 3, 4.1/4.2, 5 and 8.3; DEPLOYMENT 3.8, 4.3, 4.6, 5.4, 6.1, 7.2/7.3/7.6. This module provides GroundLinkQuery, BundleOutbox and BundleInbox, consumes E23 MissionStatePort.current() -> MissionFacts and ConfigReader, consumes environment.activated and emits ground_link.changed (SYSTEM 4.2 at docs/SYSTEM.md:92). Tables are groundlink_status, groundlink_bundle, groundlink_ack only. Use StorageSession only for these owned tables, additive migrations in the SYSTEM 4.1 adapter layout, one writer and atomic UoW/audit/outbox/ledger/replication. Store approved payload reference/hash separately from envelope attempts; no E26/E16 table access or second owner of approved clinical text. Column types preserve every schema nullable field; internal transport metadata comes only from DEPLOYMENT 4.6 and agreed P29-1/2 persistence bindings, never an improvised shared shape.

Endpoints: GET /v1/ground-link getGroundLink at docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:1837, all its declared roles; POST /v1/demo/ground-link demoSetGroundLink at :1909, operator only, GroundLinkDemoSwitch to GroundLink, Idempotency-Key/Config-Release/correlation headers exactly as declared. Generated ground-link.schema.json requires status up/delayed/down, nullable one_way_delay_s/next_contact_at/last_contact_at, source schedule/measured/demo_switch, environment_id, delay_text/delay_source_ids, gap_kind and gap_planned. Map numeric durations into unit-qualified types internally and back through boundary mappers. Enforce down gap_kind and up/delayed null gap_kind/false planned. Demo mutation is 404 NOT_FOUND outside mission SIM/REPLAY and must also obey deployment demo exposure policy; reject an unauthorized operator independently. Honor use_schedule reset. D6 same key with different status/body conflicts; identical late retry never re-flips newer state. Error codes/statuses/retryability are the generated endpoint's declarations, no RFC properties on the wire.

Read-only release content: environment-profiles.json comms_queue.simulated_one_way_delay_seconds/scheduled_status and link.sim_schedule/default_gap_kind; environment-hazards.json earth_delay/source IDs; ui-copy.json ground_link_words/gap_kind_words/designed_states/duration_words. See CONTRACTS 12 at docs/product/CONTRACTS.md:633, config-environment-profiles.schema.json:233 and config-ui-copy.schema.json:588. Do not create/edit these documents; E23/E03 own them. Schedule windows drive local state at corrected hub time, down-window ends_at gives next_contact_at, activation resets to the new environment schedule. Persist last_contact_at only for an actual crossing, not merely when toggled up. Unknown contact/delay stays null. No measured adapter is defined, so do not expose a made-up measured ingest route. D11 lifetime comes only through E01 effective overlay and E23 sourced profile; absence leaves BPv7 unavailable, while local approval and explicit simulated contact queue continue. Never use a simulated queue to claim real delivery in flight.

Before implementing public port methods, P29-1 must publish their complete signatures and the atomically approved owner-outbox handoff. Before file/crypto/agent work, P29-2/3 supplies shared atomic file recovery, enrolled key/recipient binding, actual worker descriptor/health/launch and dependencies inside this owned module. Agent health is the documented /health local worker surface, never a new hub clinical endpoint. Use the mandatory signed/encrypted file-drop path; optional DTN adapters use the configured local daemon, BPSec when real DTN, HTTPS only on Earth (DEPLOYMENT 3.8/4.6/5.4). No new deployment directory, root dependency or supervisor edit. Source/destination endpoint IDs, DTN creation/sequence, lifetime, priority, Ed25519 signature and destination encryption follow DEPLOYMENT 4.6. Never claim a native DTN implementation or LunaNet compliance. P0/P1/P2 priorities and original approval-time/ID ordering come from that section, not domain constants invented here. Same snapshot ID/hash is stable across attempt expiry/renewal; new attempt identity uses current configured lifetime, grants and bounded settings. ACK snapshot ID/hash covers all attempts; duplicate same hash is no-op, different hash is corruption. Sent/delivered/read are distinct; local file creation alone is exported, never delivered. Typed owner lifecycle/reply callbacks are P29-1, never raw table writes.

Test first under hub/tests/groundlink/ with E29-LINK (R49/D33) for generated boundaries, SIM/REPLAY/LIVE policy, schedule edges/reset, nulls, units, provenance, source copy edit, concurrent toggles, full command identity, no change on late identical retry and after-commit events. E29-OUTAGE (R61/charter 6) tests each materialize/file/send/import/ACK crash boundary, disk full, audit failure, long contact outage, duplicate/reordered input, corrupt signature/hash/recipient/epoch, retry exhaustion, byte/inflight caps, missing lifetime, expired renewal, consent removal between approval/materialize/send/import, and unavailable DTN then unavailable file transport. Use property cases for bounded envelope parsing and deduplication. Remove required versus forbidden dependencies under SYSTEM 5.7.1; neither invent nor export forbidden IDs. E29-REPLY tests incoming owner callbacks cannot alter closed care. Test clock corrections with absolute contacts and elapsed retries/arrivals across restart and mission boundaries; old events cannot overwrite newer state. Tests involving partial/disagreeing clinical values transport their approved representation unchanged; groundlink never interprets or averages them. Incapacitated crew/fixed help remain independent of worker absence.

Include real composed-HTTP GroundLink journeys and real local file-drop sender/receiver SQLite integration in these owned tests; no mock hub or fake storage counts as transport completion. Ground ground_message.changed emission follows SYSTEM 8.3 delivery-only audiences; E26 owns queued/local emission. Replies/config/evidence inbox dispatch goes through agreed E16/E26/E01/E10 ports and never auto-activates content (DEPLOYMENT 7.6). Absent optional providers leave pending/unavailable and no accepted import, not an empty success. Done requires owned gates and typed interface/launch handoff; transport positive acceptance stays blocked until shared mechanisms and real peers exist. T4 owns V/D-wide proof, not a replacement for these tests.
gates: uv run --project hub pytest -c hub/pyproject.toml -q hub/tests/groundlink --cov=crew_health.groundlink.domain --cov=crew_health.groundlink.application --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=95 --cov-report=json:/tmp/e29-t1-coverage.json
uv run --project hub ruff check hub/src/crew_health/groundlink hub/tests/groundlink
uv run --project hub ruff format --check hub/src/crew_health/groundlink hub/tests/groundlink
uv run --project hub mypy --strict hub/src/crew_health/groundlink
uv run --project hub python -m crew_health.app.import_contracts --output /tmp/crew-health-E29-T1-imports.toml && uv run --project hub lint-imports --config /tmp/crew-health-E29-T1-imports.toml
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py coverage --report /tmp/e29-t1-coverage.json
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py interfaces generated trace safety
uv run --project hub python scripts/validate_hub.py mutations

Tables are catchup_message and catchup_line only, used for immutable approved composition/projection state after the owner's approval; previews are computed and never stored. Consumes documented help.session_changed, plan_run.changed/step_done/escalated and supply.used through durable SYSTEM 5.7 subscriptions, bounded and duplicate-safe; events are invalidation/fact references, never implicit sharing or a license to mutate approved text. E16 HandoffQueries/GroundInboxView and E28 PlanCatchUpPort are named but lack agreed current complete read signatures. P29-1 must settle the exact interfaces, source facts, pinned release, caller snapshot/UoW, subject/origin/recipient/grants and bounded result types before dependent code. Import neither E26 domain types nor E24 GroundLinkInput, and define no legacy GroundLinkReader/CatchUpComposer alias. Include a transaction-bound pure composition path so E26 press can commit complete approved output without nested UoW or worker call. A missing optional provider yields a known typed unknown for its own field; StorageUnavailable/I/O/integrity/auth/config-validation errors escape, never disappear into an enrichment fallback.

E26 owns GET /v1/help-sessions/{help_session_id}/ground-message-preview previewGroundMessage, POST sibling ground-messages queueGroundMessage and GET /v1/ground-messages/{ground_message_id} getGroundMessage (OpenAPI :8934, :9011, :9110). T2 supplies the agreed composition hook but does not implement these endpoints or reimplement compose_lines. E26 HelpLogSnapshot fields/line order are in docs/tdd/E26.md:183, with SYSTEM 8.1 winning over its recomposition-at-send wording. At the same revision/pins, preview and press use the same facts/templates. E26 press stores lines/text/UTF-8 text_sha256/session_revision/catch_up and complete generated GroundMessage, state queued and allowed_actions. previewed_sha256 is recorded only, never an optimistic-lock refusal. Press may approve a newer current revision; do not promise the old preview hash when the session has changed. Once approved, new ticks/notes/configuration/late facts cannot alter content or hash. Newly shared facts require a new approval. Presentation-only leaves_at/status_text can follow current link/lifecycle while approved content stays fixed. Missing composer fallback is E26's SYSTEM 8.1 fallback with known header/answers/ticks/crew and configured unknown watch/advice, never a claim of nothing watched. T2 must not replace that fallback.

Use generated common.schema.json catch_up (what_happened/what_was_done/being_watched/advice_welcome), ground-message-preview.schema.json, ground-message.schema.json, handoff.schema.json and ground-log-view.schema.json. Read-only pinned content: ui-copy.json catch_up_words step_done_line/watch_line/advice_line/nothing_watched/headings, duration_words and designed_states.unknown; help-presentation.json ground_message templates; onboard-plans.json watch/replaces_ground_task/ground_log items and responder-flows.json through their owning ports. Nothing comes from current mutable charts or raw events unless the approved snapshot/grant includes it. Preserve source order in CONTRACTS 26: header/answers or shared concern/observations; each known done step in check_another_way/do_now or help ticks, then crew call; non-substitute-only watch lines; gap consequences then replaced ground tasks then ground_log items. Known empty and unavailable facts differ. All clinical quantities retain their units, source, age and conflict/missing status. No dose calculation or broader medicine projection. Future E32 export needs approved mapping/port; R-SYS-2 keeps FHIR disabled, and this task creates no exporter/configuration/endpoint.

Ground presentation uses next_contact_at as leaves_at only while queued/down; otherwise null, including after send. Null next contact yields configured unknown text, never an invented instant. in_time uses CONTRACTS 26 floor-to-whole-hours when at least one hour, else whole minutes, with mission time labels. Handle zero/past contact without a fabricated future duration using the agreed P29-1 presentation policy; do not invent a floor/default. Calls use a consistent ReadSnapshot/UoW and correct work pin, no wall clock or current-release substitution. Unknown facts cannot produce a safe/normal phrase. Source schedule/measured/demo_switch and LIVE/REPLAY/SIM words are separate provenance concepts, never inferred interchangeably.

Own only GET /v1/ground/log getGroundLog, OpenAPI :9785, ground role only, generated GroundLogView, declared headers/ErrorEnvelope. Return delivered authorized snapshots only, oldest first; ties, multi-gap/no-gap policy and bounded continuation require P29-2. since is inclusive; absent since uses last-gap start per OpenAPI :11638, not a guessed lookback. Use current recipient/object/field consent even after delivery; no queued item, raw plan-run link, journal, report source, prompt, participation or audit metadata leaks. A plan_run_id is included only where separately approved/currently allowed; nullability does not authorize disclosure. Exceedance of current response bounds is declared INTERNAL_ERROR rather than a truncated successful log. Long-backlog acceptance is not done until P29-2 gives complete bounded retrieval; no local cursor/query extension.

Tests first under hub/tests/catchup/: E29-OUTAGE (R61/D40/D42) for deterministic composition order, same-revision preview/press agreement, changed-revision press, tick-after-queue immutability, old pinned release after activation, unknown versus empty watch/advice, preserved conflicts/units/origins and nonclinical template edit. E29-REPLY (V95/EI5) for delivered-only log, new immutable reply references and no care mutations. E29-INDEPENDENCE (R48/EI1/EI2) for presentation-only differences and no direct consumer link reads; property tests for in_time boundaries, nullable fields, bounded sorted stable delivery results and duplicate subscription handling. Use independent expected order/privacy/unknown assertions, not expected results derived only from the same document. Include wrong-role/cross-person/narrowed grant/revocation after approval/before send/after delivery, absent/incapacitated subject, missing E16/E26/E28/E32, configuration corruption, absolute contacts/elapsed durations under clock changes, disk-full/crash at projection/subscriber-cursor commit, duplicate/reordered events and concurrent preview/press. No missing optional fact changes approved text, clears warning or blocks fixed help. Write actual getGroundLog HTTP tests through real composition and SQLite; mock queries cannot prove privacy/durability. Done requires owned gates, ratified provider handoffs and full permitted output under bounds, with unresolved long-log/FHIR acceptance reported honestly.

Build only the E29-05 For the ground card, its generated-client interaction and component/property tests inside ui/crew/src/features/catchup/. No Habitat implementation, help flow, ground console, shell, service worker, offline store, command crypto, configuration or handwritten shared wire type. Do not offer any ground control that changes a plan step, warning, help level or routine task.

Clear transient sensitive state/subscriptions before owner switch, lock, closure of grant or unmount. E29-CARD also covers missing/failed preview, error response without private fields, stale/out-of-order events, concurrent sessions, owner switch/lock while a response is pending, narrower grant, and no other-person plaintext/cache/log. Use fast-check for event/revision and immutable intent sequences. A scratch nonclinical served label edit must change rendering with unchanged frontend code. Unit API fixtures are generated package examples only; they never become a runtime fallback. Browser tests for real queued press, later help ticks, offline/restart and grant changes belong to T4 eval/scenarios/E29/, not this feature's component mocks. P29-3 must expose nonempty feature-test collection through the existing UI scripts, not add a script here. Done requires UI gates and an exact mount/client handoff; full UI acceptance waits for T4's actual E26/E16 integration, not a fake server.

There is no E29 design, request file or cold review in the inspected checkout. The product brief sections E29-01 to E29-06 and SYSTEM are the implementation authority; do not create a design. At planning time hub/, ui/, eval/, contracts/api/ and generated clients do not exist. Recheck current files and every docs/build/*/tasks.json before edits. Never create replacements for E01/provider modules, overwrite concurrent work, edit shared configuration, root tooling, other task files or pharmacy. Ownership expands only the documented SYSTEM 4.1/4.2/6.1 module/feature/test layout for the assigned module. Work only inside owned_paths, with tests there. No git or external service calls.

Use SYSTEM 5.1 IdFactory/require_id; 5.2 Clock/TimeInput/normalization and corrections; 5.3 MissionClock; 5.4 Quantity/Unit and generated boundary mappers for seconds/UCUM; 5.5 ProblemError/StorageUnavailable and ErrorEnvelope on HTTP under D5; 5.6 ConfigReader/ConfigReleaseReader/ReleaseHandle and pinned validated documents; 5.7 UnitOfWork/ReadSnapshot/DomainEventBus/OutboxSubscriptions and mandatory audience/replication declarations; 5.7.1 ReplicaExchange/Recipient/ProjectionKey/ProjectionRegistration with current field grants and policy epochs; 5.8 complete actor/key/operation/target/semantic-parameter/body CommandIdentity, mission-life ledger, AcceptedReceipt and ResultVisibility; 5.9 reference-only hash-chained audit; 5.10 generation-checked Scheduler with AbsoluteDeadline/ElapsedDeadline; 5.10.1 existing internal TaskQueue/TaskRunner only where asynchronous work is required; 5.11 validated HubSettings/SettingSpec bounds; 5.12 ModuleRegistry and normal module.py discovery. Do not define a replacement transaction, idempotency store, retry runner, clock, file-commit mechanism, lock or public Job kind. SYSTEM 6.2 uses uv run --project hub and explicit hub pytest configuration, not pharmacy's root settings; 6.3 uses pnpm and generated @crew-health/contracts; 6.4 enforces layers and link-reader restrictions. SYSTEM 7 retention/restore, 8.1 seams, 8.3 current object/field privacy, 8.6 durability and 9/10 dependencies/fakes apply.

Only groundlink itself and three consumer purposes read GroundLink: catchup ground presentation, mission Habitat/context and rules ground silence. No plans/help/handoff/assistant direct link import. Never gate care on contact, ACK or reply. E24 alone owns ground-silence warnings; E23 Habitat; E26 preview/press/help lifecycle; E16 handoff/ground console/replies; E20 offline infrastructure; E26/E28/E30 cached content; E03 shell/copy; E21 fixture/runner. Missing named protocol signatures are P29-1, not permission to copy consumer DTOs. Before dependent implementation, coordinator must publish the exact snapshot/UoW-bound signatures, release/origin/recipient/grant semantics and errors in provider-owned application ports and SYSTEM. E16 C2 (docs/build/E16/PLAN.md Requests) also exposes a SYSTEM contradiction: handoff consumes BundleOutbox in 4.2, but 6.4 forbids its import of groundlink.application.ports. P29-1 must resolve that command-only boundary without a fourth GroundLinkQuery reader; do not invent a new module/path or broaden the import allowlist locally. P29-2 covers shared file recovery and bounded complete ground-log shape; P29-3 infrastructure/tooling/traces; P29-4 mounts/content/providers. Return requested changes to the coordinator for filing in docs/requests/E29.md; that path is outside this task. A pending request is not accepted contract support.

No em/en dash or spaced hyphen dash in authored files.

Build only cross-epic E29 software acceptance and bounded evidence publication under eval/scenarios/E29/. Do not fix any provider or task's code, edit E21 registry/fixture/runner, create a new launcher/framework or write product code. Source: docs/product/tdd/E29.md E29-01 to E29-06; docs/product/VALIDATION.md:101, :113, :115, :117, :188 to :198; SYSTEM 4.3, 8.7/8.8, 9/10; BUILD-CHARTER 6 to 8. Stable IDs in this brief are new test identities to register through P29-3, not invented product identifiers. T1/T2/T3 own the implementation and lower-level tests. Use actual E21 frozen demo fixture, normal create_app(settings), HTTP/session/configuration APIs, real temporary SQLite and generated models, or the E21/E20 supported Playwright launcher against that actual hub. Required hard runtime dependencies are E01/E23 per SYSTEM 9; individual positive scenarios additionally require the real E02/E16/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E30/E20 providers they exercise. Kernel fakes only prove units; do not earn acceptance with provider substitutes. Missing provider/clock/fault/trace control/browser/tool is P29-3/4 and a blocked gate, not skip, xfail, empty result or changed criterion. External model/devices/ground transport can be absent or documented external adapters as the scenario requires; all model-free paths run stopped.

E29-LINK (R49, E29-01/05, D33): through actual E23 environment proposal/confirmation, Mara activates lunar_surface in SIM, then authenticated operator calls demoSetGroundLink with the source demo fixture's planned next contact. Assert getGroundLink generated fields and actual ground_link.changed after each committed change, source demo_switch with displayed Sim, source IDs, next/last contact truth, expected Habitat ground line and unchanged remaining Habitat content. Also prove SIM/REPLAY demo routes versus LIVE 404, operator-only auth and schedule restoration. Use real E23 activation, not just an HTTP status or a manually manufactured environment row.

E29-INDEPENDENCE (R48, E29-02, EI1/EI2/EI5, V81, D34/D43): hold one injected clock instant and release/person/grant/input state; switch up/delayed/down through the real API with distinct keys and no other care mutation. Capture getPlan for ICL10, getHelpSession eye_injury plus the served flow content, getKitMap, listWarnings, getRoutineToday and getRoutineWeek. These operationIds are in opened docs/product/api/openapi.yaml:6511, :8637, :6267, :2528, :2807, :2872. Compare deterministic serialized response bytes after replacing only ground_log stage link_text/leaves_at in PlanView (plan-view.schema.json:884), For a separate getHabitatView comparison, allow only ground_link.status, ground_link.one_way_delay_s, ground_link.next_contact_at, ground_link.last_contact_at, ground_link.source, ground_link.gap_kind and ground_link.gap_planned; keep environment_id, delay_text, delay_source_ids and all other Habitat fields unchanged. Test message lifecycle presentation separately, not as an exemption from care-state equality. Assert actual difference paths are a subset of those exact schema leaves; no blanket removal by name, string matching, whole stage/link object, arbitrary timestamp, IDs, revisions, ordering, care state or warning row. Equal list counts are insufficient. Compare plan-run and help care state without exemptions for new wait states. Planned gap or null silence threshold holds warnings invariant in this test; the positive warning case is separate. Capture actual reference-only read trace supplied by P29-3 and validate caller purpose: groundlink provider, catchup ground stage/messages, mission Habitat/context, rules ground_silence only. No plan/routine/help/assistant safety read or ground reply precondition. Validate every effective configuration predicate/rule and the exact PlanRun/HelpSession/Handoff/GuidedCheck state sets under CONTRACTS 28 rule.ground/ei.states and the hub corpus gate; no link/reply precondition outside ground_silence or permitted presentation. Do not treat an import-only scan as configuration proof. Use SYSTEM 6.4's real AST/import generator against actual source/config/built inventories, including aliases, direct imports, indirect dependency resolution and dynamic-import rejection. Reuse the shared scanner rather than a second generalized scanner; E29 owns narrow assertions over it. Add negative controls that plant a forbidden module/alias/DI reader in a temporary scanner input and a non-ground response difference; the gate must fail. Missing or incomplete trees/trace can never pass. This does not authorize production monkeypatch instrumentation.

Publish a bounded privacy-safe result artifact within this owned scenario directory through E21's agreed artifact writer. Include actual run/build/config/base/effective/overlay hashes, fixed time, source inventory/scan/read trace verdict, per-response hashes, exact allowed differences and scenario outcomes. Keep synthetic fixture payloads in temporary run storage if full byte evidence is needed, never publish live clinical text. E21 owns final result-panel/registry aggregation and actual output naming/schema/writer under P29-3. No guessed shared report type, alternate commit-marker mechanism or success artifact before the assertions finish.

E29-SILENCE (R49, E29-03, V93, D35): activate a scratch provenance-bearing SIM release with ground_silence.after_next_contact_seconds nonnull through the normal loader; never edit the warning level/mapping or shipped threshold. With actual E24, unplanned down after next contact plus threshold raises watch/rule once; equality/before, null threshold, unknown contact and planned gap do not. Planned contact remains D35. Corrected clock, retries, moved contact, legitimate return of link, withdrawn definition and old delayed events preserve SYSTEM 5.10/D1/D3 behavior and never clear from a failed evaluation. E24 owns algorithm/fixes. Do not hide this intentional warning delta by widening V81's exemption.

E29-OUTAGE (R61, E29-04/05, D40/D42, BUILD-CHARTER 6): actual E16 previewHandoff/approveHandoff and E26 previewGroundMessage/queueGroundMessage persist approved snapshots with current grants, leaves_at equal to known next contact while down and all nullable fields valid. Drive the mounted T3 card with Playwright: preview/press, keep ticking help steps and progressing/completing the plan afterward; ordered plan stages have ground_log last/nonblocking. With the real E01 durable clock/fault controls, interrupt before/after owner acceptance, projection/cursor commit, bundle publication/send/import/ACK, fill disk, restart and retry beyond 24 hours. Restore contact and prove every approved ID/hash appears at the ground exactly once with accurate sent/delivered/read and simulation labels, not merely equal queue counts. Renew expired envelopes with unchanged content, bounded attempts and no starvation; remove DTN to exercise real file-drop backup, then remove file transport to prove visible retained queue. Grant loss at materialize/send/renew/import/read and restore from a pre-revocation backup denies; wrong actor/target/parameters/body with a reused command key cannot execute or replay. Approval content cannot change after later ticks, correction or release activation. Use real R-SYS-2 mapping absence to prove FHIR unavailable while approved snapshots continue; no speculative FHIR endpoint. Oversized log cannot become truncated 200; full backlog retrieval remains blocked until P29-2 continuation lands.

E29-REPLY (R61, V95, EI5): use real recordHandoffReceipt/replyToHandoff and recordGroundMessageReceipt/replyToGroundMessage (OpenAPI :9603/:9695/:9416/:9508) plus T1 transport to return authenticated replies after plan/help closure. A new attributed record/log reference is appended once; care state/steps/level/routine/warnings never change. Duplicate/out-of-order reply/ACK, invalid recipient/signature/hash/epoch, corrupt/missing required dependency and forbidden optional dependency follow SYSTEM 5.7.1 without leaking IDs or applying partial state. Acknowledgment is not clinical review. Both positive permitted reads and wrong-role/cross-owner denial are necessary. Journal/report/private-note canaries must be absent from recipient decrypted payloads, authorized events, files before encryption and diagnostics; ciphertext searching alone proves nothing. No raw clinical export joins or blanket ground chart grant.

E29-OFFLINE (R62, E29-06, V97): using the actual supported crew browser/device profiles, load versioned E20 cache with E26 help and E28 plan/E30 teach content, authenticate only where needed for clinical state, stop hub/model/devices/link, then open fixed first help screen before auth/network and render active plan steps with their pinned release. Teach steps are available from versioned public content. Restart browser and exercise last good release, corrupted update, atomic activation, open-work old pins and owner switch; never show someone else's clinical run from a public cache. Use real service worker/offline mechanism and actual hub absence, not route interception or static screenshots. E20/E26/E28/E30 own cache fixes. Include laptop and supported tablet viewport/browser profiles; report physical hardware as unmeasured when absent, not proof from emulation. Station cannot read clinical plan lists under D9.

Across scenarios inject AGENTS 6 failures: process/power interruption, duplicated/retried/late input, clock jump and mission boundary, disk full, corrupt/missing config, concurrent clients, long backlog, incapacitated/absent crew and cross-crew privacy. Partial/disagreeing measurements remain unit/source-qualified conflicts or unknown in approved summaries, never averaged or fabricated. Prove T1/T2/T3 nonclinical copy/config-edit behavior through real activation as well as their unit tests. Preserve the real fallback, current authority, privacy and release validation for every assertion. Test only documented source expectations; no clinical golden output generated from its own input configuration. Final done requires all six nonempty scenario groups and every assigned R/V/D/EI clause, current compatible artifact, all task/full hub gates, actual branch/full-condition/complexity/mutation/trace gates supplied under P29-3, independent build review and CI. Report blocked/live/hardware/FHIR limitations separately and return each reproducible defect to its file owner.
